meta.input_constraint: lawful input side is at most 10, so output_scale 3 stays within the ARC 30x30 bound

program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         (diag (for/list ((i (range 0 (min h w))))
                 (at g i i)))
         (active-diag
          (let loop ((d diag))
            (if (or (empty? d) (!= (last d) 0))
                d
                (loop (take d (- (length d) 1))))))
         (period (length active-diag))
         (oh (* h 3))
         (ow (* w 3)))
    (build-grid oh ow (r c)
      (nth active-diag (remainder (max r c) period))))))
